title: Granular p95/p99 telemetry and dashboards per endpoint/model/region
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Provide per-endpoint, per-model, per-region p95 and p99 latency visibility and regression detection alongside tokens/sec metrics. Current telemetry surfaces aggregate percentiles across fleets; customers and SREs need sliceable quantiles by route (API endpoint), model variant, and region to diagnose regressions (e.g., model rollout vs. infra issue) and make routing/fallback decisions. This ticket implements: 1) telemetry emission changes to tag latency events with route/model/region and tokens_emitted, 2) backend pipeline changes to store and compute p95/p99 efficiently (TDigest/HDR rollups + minute-level rollups), 3) dashboard and alerting definitions with deterministic regression thresholds, and 4) integration with the load-testing harness so synthetic runs produce labeled signals for baseline comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Telemetry: all inference nodes emit per-request latency_ms, tokens_out, route, model_id, region, and sample_key in tracing envelope. 2) Storage: Quantile estimator streams accepted into ClickHouse/metrics service producing minute and hourly rollups by {route,model_id,region}. 3) Dashboards: New dashboard with filter bar (route, model, region, timeframe) and widgets: tokens/sec heatmap, p95 timeseries, p99 timeseries, percentile-attribution table. 4) Alerts: Regression alert that fires when p95 increases >25% vs baseline for 5m with traffic >500 req/min for that slice, plus secondary tokens/sec drop rule. 5) Load harness: infer-bench produces labeled synthetic traffic (route/model/region combos) and stores baseline snapshots for comparison. 6) Unit/integration tests for ingestion and aggregation logic + PRs merged and e2e verified in staging.
implementation_notes: Telemetry changes: add telemetry tag keys 'route', 'model_id', 'region', 'tokens_out' and ensure KV cache hits are tagged to avoid double-counting. Use TDigest at ingestion for per-minute quantile approximation and persist digest blobs for 1h and merge into hourly rollups. Storage: store minute_rollup: {start_ts, tags, tdigest_blob, count, mean} and materialize p95/p99 using tdigest.compress. Queries: example SQL for ClickHouse: SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS minute, quantileExact(0.95)(latency_ms) FROM request_latency WHERE route='v1/chat' AND model_id='redwood-1.3' AND region='us-west' GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute. For large-cardinality cases fallback to digest-based functions. Backpressure: if tag-cardinality > threshold, fall back to coarse model or sampling. Instrumentation: change runtime to emit a lightweight span for token_emission so tokens/sec can be derived without blocking request path.
dashboard_spec: Top-level filter: timeframe, region, route, model_id. Widgets: 1) Tokens/sec heatmap (by minute, shading by p95 bucket) 2) p95 line chart with baseline band shading (baseline computed from rolling 7-day median) 3) p99 line chart 4) Slice comparison table (columns: route, model_id, region, req/s, p50, p95, p99, p95_delta%) 5) Regression timeline with links to failing test harness runs and implicated commits. Dashboard should include a 'compare to baseline' toggle and an export CSV action.
alerting_rules: Primary alert: slice_p95_regression -> when p95_current > p95_baseline * 1.25 AND requests_in_window > 500 for 5m -> Severity: Sev3 -> Notify: #sre-performance, owner on-call. Secondary alert: tokens_drop -> tokens/sec for slice drops by >40% vs baseline for 3m -> Severity: Sev3. Noise control: automatic suppression for slices with fewer than 1000 total requests in last 24h. Alerts should include examples and links to dashboard with pre-filtered slice.
load_harness_integration: Add a job variant to infer-bench that tags synthetic traffic with 'synthetic:true' and enumerates representative route/model/region combos. Harness outputs: per-run digest blobs and summary CSV (req_count, tokens_out, p50/p95/p99). Store runs in baseline bucket and implement an automated regression detector that compares new runs to baselines and creates a Linear issue if >15% p95 regression across top-5 slices.
risks_and_mitigation: 1) Cardinality explosion: mitigate by sampling high-cardinality routes and aggregate at model-family level. 2) Increased telemetry volume: apply adaptive sampling and tdigest compression. 3) False positives from small-sample slices: use minimum-request thresholds in alerts and dashboards. 4) Backfill complexity: only backfill hourly rollups; minute-level historicals will be best-effort.
testing_plan: Unit tests for ingestion pipeline and tdigest merge logic; integration test that runs infer-bench synthetic traffic into staging and verifies p95/p99 appear in dashboard within 3 minutes; smoke test to ensure alerts fire under simulated regression. Add a chaos scenario that increases latency on a controlled subset to validate detection path.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flag telemetry emission for 48 hours in staging. 2) Enable digest generation in staging and validate dashboards. 3) Gradual rollout to production 10%->50%->100% of inference nodes across regions over 48h, monitor telemetry volume and SLOs. 4) After 72h full rollout, enable regression automated Linear creation. Postmortem window: 14 days for tuning thresholds.
